title: Reconcile density tokens with virtualized table resize interactions
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Align spacing/density tokens with runtime behavior of virtualized tables and redefine the column-resize interaction so it remains predictable across density modes and when rows are recycled. This ticket covers token mapping (compact/comfortable/expanded), visual affordance for crosshair and live width preview, keyboard accessibility for resizing, and perf-safe animations for column width transitions in virtualized contexts.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Density token map exists that deterministically produces row height, cell padding, and header height for each density mode (compact/regular/comfortable). 2) Column resize uses a lightweight overlay (crosshair) that does not force full reflow of virtualized rows. 3) Live width preview is optional and can be toggled via user preference; default is overlay ruler to avoid expensive DOM remeasure. 4) Keyboard resize (+/- and PageUp/PageDown) supported and announces new width to screen readers. 5) End-to-end performance tests show no >10% increase in frame time for large tables (50k rows) during resize gestures. 6) Design tokens are documented with migration notes for components and theme consumers.
design_notes: Background: We currently have inconsistent density token usage between DataTable and VirtualList which causes jumpiness when column widths change because row padding/line-height are recalculated at the same time as cell recycling. Proposed approach: - Create density token scale (ds-density-compact, ds-density-default, ds-density-spacious) that maps to numeric values for rowHeight, cellPaddingX, cellPaddingY, headerHeight, and responsive breakpoints. - Introduce a 'resize-overlay' pattern: a thin absolute-positioned element painted above virtualization layer to show guide and drag handle; width adjustments are applied to column model only after drag end or on throttled intervals. - Provide an opt-in 'liveResize' hook for low-latency setups (Dedicated), which uses requestAnimationFrame and kernel to allow live cell width recalculation. - Accessibility: announce resize start/end and new pixel width; provide aria-live region. - Visual design: crosshair uses 1px token stroke and semi-transparent fill during press; preserve contrast against dark/light tokens. - Tokens must be theme-aware (support for custom scale in Private deployments).
implementation_plan: 1) Define token spec and add to tokens.json with examples. 2) Update VirtualList to expose a stable 'overlay-layer' portal that never unmounts during row recycling. 3) Implement resize-overlay component with a11y behaviors. 4) Wire column model changes through ColumnController with batched updates. 5) Add feature flag 'ds_resize_livepreview' to gate live preview. 6) QA perf and accessibility. 7) Ship docs and migration guide.
risks: - Live preview can be CPU intensive on low-end devices; must default off and be gated by runtime heuristics. - Changing token scale may affect other components that assumed previous line-heights; migration guide required. - Interaction semantics must remain consistent with keyboard navigation to avoid regressions for power users.
open_questions: - Should liveResize be enabled automatically for Dedicated customers with GPU-accelerated browsers? - Do product teams want per-table overrides for density token (or only global theme-level control)? - How should column min/max behave across density modes? Current min-widths were tuned for default density.
